definitions.explanation: An organized set of principles, methods, or doctrines forming a coherent whole.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学問|がくもん}→学問：02604_gakumon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{体系|たいけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。

notes:
{体系|たいけい} refers to a coherent, organized system of knowledge or principles.
